verses.en: Send ye the lamb to the ruler of the land from Sela to the wilderness, unto the mount of the daughter of Zion.
verses.sm: Moapi ma e ua totoe i le laueleele. la outou avatu le tamai mamoe i le alii e pule i le nuu, e alu atu i Sela e ui atu i le vao, i le mauga o le tama fafine a Siona.

verses.en: For it shall be, that, as a wandering bird cast out of the nest, so the daughters of Moab shall be at the fords of Arnon.
verses.sm: Auá e pei o le manu ua sola ua tulia i lona ofaga, e faapea tama fafine a Maopi i a3ada o O le malaia o Moapi Arinona.

verses.en: Take counsel, execute judgment; make thy shadow as the night in the midst of the noonday; hide the outcasts; bewray not him that wandereth.
verses.sm: Ina fai ia sau pule, ina faatonu mai ia; ia outou faapaolo mai, peiseai o le po le aoauli; ina nanā ia i e ua tulia, aua neʻi faaalia e ua sosola.

verses.en: Let mine outcasts dwell with thee, Moab; be thou a covert to them from the face of the spoiler: for the extortioner is at an end, the spoiler ceaseth, the oppressors are consumed out of the land.
verses.sm: Seʻi tou mau ia ma e ua tulia o Moapi; ia fai oe ma lafitaga ia te i latou i le na te faaumatia; aua e mavae atu le ua faasaua, e uma foi le malaia, e faaumatia le na solia i latou ai le laueleele.

verses.en: And in mercy shall the throne be established: and he shall sit upon it in truth in the tabernacle of David, judging, and seeking judgment, and hasting righteousness.
verses.sm: Ona faatumauina lea o le nofoalii i le alofa, e nofo ai foi ma le faamaoni i le fale ie o Tavita, o le na te faamasinoina, ma tausisi i le faamasinoga, e faataalise foi o ia i le amiotonu.

verses.en: We have heard of the pride of Moab; he is very proud: even of his haughtiness, and his pride, and his wrath: but his lies shall not be so.
verses.sm: Ua matou faalogo atu i le faamaualuga o Moapi, ua matua faamaualuga ia, o lona faamaualuga, ma lona faasiasia ma lona faasausili; e pepelo ana upu faatauvaa.

verses.en: Therefore shall Moab howl for Moab, every one shall howl: for the foundations of Kir-hareseth shall ye mourn; surely they are stricken.
verses.sm: O le mea lea e wo ai Moapi ona o Moapi, e uio i latou uma lava; tou te feoi Ona O faavae O Kiriaresa, ua taia lava i latou.

verses.en: For the fields of Heshbon languish, and the vine of Sibmah: the lords of the heathen have broken down the principal plants thereof, they are come even unto Jazer, they wandered through the wilderness: her branches are stretched out, they are gone over the sea.
verses.sm: Aua ua mamae fanua o Hesepona; o le vine o Sepema ua gauieseina ona la e alii o nuu ese; na latou oo i lasaru, na sosolo atu i le vao; na salalau ona la, na sopoia atu le sami.

verses.en: Therefore I will bewail with the weeping of Jazer the vine of Sibmah: I will water thee with my tears, O Heshbon, and Elealeh: for the shouting for thy summer fruits and for thy harvest is fallen.
verses.sm: O le mea lea ou te tagi ai ma le tagi o Iasaru ona o le vine o Sepema; ou te faasúsúina oe i ou loimata, Hesepona e ma Eleale e; aua ua pa atu le alaga i a outou fua otatà, ma la outou seleselegasaito.

verses.en: And gladness is taken away, and joy out of the plentiful field; and in the vineyards there shall be no singing, neither shall there be shouting: the treaders shall tread out no wine in their presses; I have made their vintage shouting to cease.
verses.sm: Io Ua aveesea foi le fiafia ma le olioli i le fanua lafulemu, e leai se alaga fiafia, e leai foi se pisa i tovine; o lē solia vine na te le solia ni uaina i soligavine; ua ou faaiuina le alaga fiafia.

verses.en: Wherefore my bowels shall sound like an harp for Moab, and mine inward parts for Kir-haresh.
verses.sm: O le mea lea e tagi ai loʻu manava pei o le kitara ona o Moapi, atoa ma loʻu loto ona o Kiriaresa.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, when it is seen that Moab is weary on the high place, that he shall come to his sanctuary to pray; but he shall not prevail.
verses.sm: A iloa foi Moapi pe a lailoa o ia i luga o le mea maualuga, ona alu atu ai lea o ia i lona malumalu e tatalo ai, a e le mafai o ia.

verses.en: This is the word that the LORD hath spoken concerning Moab since that time.
verses.sm: O le afioga lea a le ALII na ia fetalai mai ai ia Moapi anamua; `14 a o ona po nei o loo fetalai mai ai le ALII,

verses.en: But now the LORD hath spoken, saying, Within three years, as the years of an hireling, and the glory of Moab shall be contemned, with all that great multitude; and the remnant shall be very small and feeble.
verses.sm: o loo faapea mai, o tausaga e tolu, e tusa ma tausaga O le ua galue i le taui, e ta‘ufaatauvaaina. ai le mamalu o Moapi, ma le vao tagata uma e toatele; o e ua totoe foi e matua toaitiiti lava i latou, e leai se malosi.
